name: Depth-free motion evidence (Epipolar Residual)
aliases: Epipolar Line Distance for Motion Evidence
Epipolar Residual for Depth-Free Motion Evidence
definition: Measures motion evidence by calculating the distance from each measured correspondence to its epipolar line in pixels. It uses no correct depth, only camera pose, making it robust against noisy monocular depth that defeats rigid-flow residuals.
summary: Epipolar Residual detects motion by measuring point-to-line distance using arbitrary depths, making it robust against noisy monocular depth that defeats rigid-flow residuals.
